stations.name: State Broadcast
stations.text: ... thanks to the Chairman's expansion program, three more southern districts have been successfully stabilized ...

stations.name: Public Radio
stations.text: ... Free Coast Radio has stopped transmitting after twenty years on air ... no official explanation has been released ...

stations.name: Weather Relay
stations.text: ... dense fog moving through the western hills ... long-range visibility near zero ...

stations.name: Checkpoint North
stations.text: ... papers verified ... proceed to secondary inspection ...

stations.name: Maintenance Channel
stations.text: ... tower lights on sector C failed again during the night ...

stations.name: Civilian Frequency
stations.text: ... train station's been closed for weeks now ... nobody even announces it anymore ...

stations.name: Emergency Channel
stations.text: ... unidentified vehicle abandoned near border marker eight ...

stations.name: Music Station
stations.text: ... due to new communication policies tonight's independent program will not continue ...

stations.name: Military Relay
stations.text: ... convoy delayed by inspection teams ... awaiting clearance ...

stations.name: Late Night Radio
stations.text: ... remember when people used to travel without permits? feels unreal now ...

stations.name: State Announcement
stations.text: ... the Chairman will address the nation this Friday regarding recent international victories ...

stations.name: Town Dispatch
stations.text: ... curfew violations decreasing for the fourth consecutive month ...

stations.name: Harbor Frequency
stations.text: ... cargo inspections extended to all civilian deliveries entering the coast ...

stations.name: Old Broadcast Tape
stations.text: ... this station is funded by listeners across the valley ... thank you for staying with us ...

stations.name: Internal Security
stations.text: ... all operators are reminded that unsanctioned listening remains prohibited ...

stations.name: Railway Control
stations.text: ... line seven remains inactive pending infrastructure repairs ...

stations.name: Local Radio
stations.text: ... people gathered in the square again after the speech ... largest crowd in years ...

stations.name: Broken Frequency
stations.text: ... [static] ... transmission source unavailable ...

stations.name: Border Patrol
stations.text: ... inspection teams requested additional floodlights near the outer fence ...

stations.name: State Frequency
stations.text: ... production targets exceeded once again under the Chairman's direction ...
